title: Torque Sequencing for Multi-Bolt Fasteners
bodyText: A chainring or any multi-bolt fastener is torqued in a star or criss-cross pattern, never straight around the circle. Bring every bolt to roughly half the target value on the first pass, then complete each bolt to full value on the second pass in the same star sequence. This spreads clamping force evenly and keeps the component from cocking on its seat.
